outcome: mRNA expression levels of glucocorticoid receptor subtypes GRα and GRβ
cohort: The study included 32 very low birth weight cesarean section infants, term planned cesarean section infants, and 43 VLBW infants for longitudinal analysis.
finding: The GRα/GRβ expression ratio at birth was significantly lower in VLBW CS infants compared to term planned CS infants, and this ratio increased from day 0 to days 4-7 in VLBW infants.
mod_finding: The GRα/GRβ expression ratio at birth was significantly lower in 32 VLBW cesarean section infants than in term planned cesarean section infants.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight (VLBW) infants and term infants
gest_age: VLBW infants (implying very preterm) and term infants
